cn.t: Court Theatre's "Antigone" provides a captivating, intimate finale to its Oedipus trilogy. Critics praise Gabrielle Randle-Bent's spare direction that makes Greek tragedy accessible while breathing fresh life into Sophocles' timeless tale of defiance.
